# BookKraft AI

_Last updated: 2026-08-10_

> BookKraft AI is a one-time-purchase eBook formatting toolkit for indie authors. It provides 16 tools that take a manuscript from raw draft to a publish-ready EPUB or Kindle file, covering formatting cleanup, EPUB generation, table of contents creation, front/back matter generation, EPUB validation, metadata building, and AI-powered manuscript editing. No subscriptions. Credits never expire. Five tools are free forever with no signup required.

BookKraft AI exists to replace expensive one-time desktop software (Vellum, $250, Mac-only; Atticus, $147) with a cheaper, AI-assisted, browser-based alternative starting at $19 one-time. Output is compatible with Amazon KDP, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Draft2Digital, Smashwords, OverDrive, Tolino, and Scribd.

## Core facts

- Pricing model: one-time purchase, no subscriptions. AI tools use credits that never expire.
- Free tier: 5 tools (EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Manuscript Cleanup Checker, Full Manuscript Mode) — no account or signup required, unlimited use.
- Starter: $19, includes 5 formatting logic tools (unlocked forever) + 40 AI credits.
- Pro: $49, includes 5 formatting logic tools (unlocked forever) + 200 AI credits.
- Lifetime Access: $149, all 16 tools, unlimited AI runs (rate limited), all future tools included.
- AI tools run on Claude Haiku by Anthropic.
- Refund policy: 7-day money-back guarantee on any purchase.
- Checkout is handled via Paddle.

## Tools

### Free tools (no account required)

- EPUB Validator — checks an EPUB file for structure errors, missing metadata, and content issues before uploading to KDP or IngramSpark; free, no signup needed.
- Metadata Builder — builds complete book metadata for KDP, IngramSpark, Draft2Digital, and EPUB OPF files, including keywords, BISAC categories, and pricing fields; free, no account required.
- Cover Checker — validates cover image dimensions, DPI, and format requirements for KDP and EPUB; free, no signup needed.
- Word Manuscript Cleanup Checker — scans a manuscript for formatting issues introduced by Word or Google Docs; free, no account required.
- Full Manuscript Mode — uploads a .docx or .txt manuscript, detects chapters, cleans formatting, and outputs a complete EPUB 3.0 file in one step; free, no login required.

### Formatting logic tools (included in Starter and Pro, no credits used)

- Kindle Format Fixer — fixes smart quotes, em dashes, double spaces, and encoding errors from Word/Google Docs exports.
- EPUB Formatter — generates a valid EPUB 3.0 file from a manuscript, handling chapter breaks, metadata, and cover embedding.
- TOC Generator — builds a clickable Table of Contents for Kindle, EPUB3, and NCX formats.
- Front Matter Generator — generates title page, copyright page, dedication, and disclaimer.
- CSS Snippet Generator — generates copy-paste CSS for drop caps, scene breaks, blockquotes, and pull quotes for Kindle KFX and EPUB.

### AI tools (use credits, available in all paid plans)

- Manuscript Cleanup — catches dialogue punctuation errors, repeated words, and clichés; scales with manuscript length (~1 credit per 10,000 words); free 500-word sample available.
- Print-to-Digital Adapter — converts print-specific elements (page references, footnotes, running headers) into eBook-ready format; scales with length.
- Back Matter Generator — writes author bio, mailing list CTA, Also By section, and closing note; costs 2 credits.
- EPUB Validator Pro — deep AI validation including ghost spacing detection, duplicate ID scan, OPF manifest check, and store-specific pass/fail reports for KDP, Apple Books, and Google Play; costs 2 credits.
- Style Sheet Auditor — scans for style inconsistencies (character names, capitalization, hyphenation, dialogue punctuation); free 500-word sample available.
- KDP Keyword & Category Finder — generates long-tail KDP keywords and full Amazon category paths; costs 1 credit.

## Frequently asked

- BookKraft AI has no monthly fees; every purchase is one-time and credits never expire.
- EPUB works on Apple Books, Kobo, and Barnes & Noble; Kindle/MOBI/KFX works only on Amazon devices. BookKraft AI tools support both formats.
- The 5 free tools (EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Manuscript Cleanup Checker, Full Manuscript Mode) require no account, email, or credit card.
- AI tools use Claude Haiku by Anthropic for formatting and analysis tasks.
- Manuscript Cleanup and Style Sheet Auditor offer a free 500-word sample before purchasing credits.
